jobs.title: VP of Customer Success
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is not a typical Customer Success role. You'll own net revenue retention across renewals, expansion, training, and customer marketing for a global customer base, with a direct line into shaping the product itself.

 

We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.

Why join Kognity?

  • Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 140 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.

  • High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.

  • A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.

  • Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.

What you'll do:

  • Own and achieve the NRR target for Customer Success across all markets, covering renewals and expansion

  • Build a structure across Account Management, Training, Professional Development and Customer Marketing with clear roles and no major gaps or overlaps

  • Own, develop and implement the CS strategy and post-sales processes across markets, with full decision-making authority over prioritisation, team structure and resource allocation

  • Set a clear approach for how CS uses communication and training to drive adoption and retention.

  • Advise the leadership team on Customer Success strategy and forecasts alongside the CRO, and lead cross-team collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Product, Content and Enablement

What we're looking for:

  • Proven track record of growing net revenue retention through renewals and upsell strategies in a SaaS business

  • Strategic thinking beyond Account Management, with clear prioritisation in a complex environment and strong judgement in ambiguity

  • Ability to lead and inspire with confidence for maximum revenue outcomes, and to build capability in others

  • Ability to effectively identify problems with impact on NRR within and outside the CS team, and develop and implement appropriate solution sets

  • Executive-level communication and cross-functional influence, with the ability to work closely with senior stakeholders across the business

How we hire

  1. Discovery call with a Recruiter

  2. Hiring manager discussion

  3. Case study

  4. Values discussion

  5. Leadership talk

  6. References

Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

See more about how we collect and process your personal data in our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is a chance to own and modernise the financial backbone of a growing EdTech business, building the processes, controls and external partnerships that keep accounting accurate and compliant across Sweden, the UK and the US.

You'll report to our CFO and work closely with our Financial Controller and FP&A Specialist, a dynamic and driven team that shares ownership of Kognity's financial health.

We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.

Why join Kognity?

  • Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 140 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.

  • High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.

  • A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.

  • Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.

What you'll do:

  • Own the end-to-end accounting processes at Kognity, including monthly and annual close, statutory reporting, expense handling and supplier payments, making sure the systems, processes and partners needed are in place, and gaps are caught early

  • Own Kognity's banking relationships and payment processes. Take accountability for daily payments and liquidity management, keeping cash positions known and FX managed proactively

  • Take accountability for timely audit and tax compliance across every jurisdiction Kognity operates in, and for designing and maintaining internal controls fit for a growing tech company

  • Partner closely with the Order-to-Cash/A/R team, People & Culture and the wider business, making sure accounting requirements are understood and followed outside of finance

What we're looking for:

  • Strong understanding of accounting, audit, statutory reporting and tax in an international business environment

  • Strong understanding of the Swedish K3 accounting framework

  • Curiosity about and a desire to drive process automation and the implementation of AI tooling

  • Experience managing outsourced or external accounting firms as service partners

  • Experience running audit and tax compliance processes

  • Ability to explain and discuss accounting and compliance requirements in plain terms to non-finance colleagues

How we hire

  1. Discovery call with a Recruiter

  2. Hiring manager discussion

  3. Case study

  4. Values discussion

  5. Leadership talk

  6. References

Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

See more about how we collect and process your personal data in our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Delivery Coordinator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.

Why join Kognity?

  • Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 100 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.

  • High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.

  • A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.

  • Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.

What you'll do

As a Delivery Coordinator, you will get a chance to keep content work moving reliably across Kognity's Content Operations team, its freelance contributors and the Product and Tech teams it depends on.

  • Deliver small content update projects, acting as the single point of contact from brief through authoring, QA and upload to live deployment, ensuring every asset quality.

  • Run the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, from sourcing and briefing freelance subject specialists to onboarding, tracking assignments and closing out engagements cleanly.

  • Triage and route incoming content feedback from users and internal teams, tracking it through to resolution and surfacing patterns that shape content priorities.

  • Work on third-party content rights, permissions and licensing, keeping records audit-ready and escalating copyright questions to the right stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain the trackers, dashboards and documentation that give the content team visibility over its work, and help bring AI tools into everyday content operations.

What we're looking for

  • Background in content coordination, project coordination or operations, ideally within tech, product, digital publishing or EdTech.

  • Proven ability to keep multiple workstreams organised and moving, ideally with a tracker or system you've built to manage competing priorities.

  • Strong communication skills, able to adjust tone and detail for audiences from freelance contributors to legal and finance stakeholders.

  • Fast learner who picks up new tools, platforms and content systems quickly, with minimal repeated guidance.

  • Skilled at turning scattered information, such as feedback threads or contractor performance notes, into clear improvements patterns and concrete recommendations.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance creativity, decisions, and execution

Our values

  • We take ownership

  • We are transparent

  • We make every week count

  • We obsess over customers

  • We show up with heart

How we hire

  1. Discovery call with a Recruiter

  2. Hiring manager discussion

  3. Case study

  4. Values discussion

  5. Leadership talk

  6. References

Equal opportunity

Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

 

See more about how we collect and process your personal data in our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in content and social media marketing while helping Kognity reach and support IB educators worldwide. You’ll contribute to content, campaigns and research, working closely with our Content Marketing Manager and the wider Marketing team.

We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.

Why join Kognity?

  • Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 140 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.

  • Build practical marketing experience – You’ll contribute to real content, campaigns and research and see how marketing supports growth. You will be trusted to take initiative and make decisions.

  • Learn alongside an experienced team – You’ll work with smart, driven colleagues across demand generation, brand, thought leadership, and go-to-market enablement, with mentorship from our Content Marketing Manager.

  • Develop in a collaborative environment – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.

What you’ll do

As a Content Marketing Intern you will get a chance to help shape how Kognity talks to IB educators, across blogs, podcasts, email and social. Your work may include:

  • Create and adapt blogs, social posts, educator-facing articles, testimonials and email copy that bring Kognity's IB messaging to life for teachers worldwide.

  • Support thought-leadership content creation, including our IB Unplugged podcast, that showcases Kognity's expertise to the IB community.

  • Support our social media presence through scheduling, community engagement, and performance tracking.

  • Run market and competitor research across the IB and EdTech space, turning findings into insights the team can act on.

  • Use AI tools responsibly to sharpen research, improve workflows and develop content more efficiently.

What we’re looking for

  • You are currently enrolled in an educational programme in Marketing (content & social media) or a related field, and eligible to complete an internship as part of your academic programme.

  • Ideally, you are an IB Diploma Programme graduate and have first-hand knowledge of the programme.

  • You write and speak fluent English, with a strong interest in clear, persuasive, and engaging copy.

  • You have experience leveraging AI tools to enhance creativity, decisions, and execution.

Who will thrive in the role

  • You take initiative, moving work forward without waiting to be asked, and keep others updated on progress.

  • You can manage multiple work streams at once, planning your own workload and aligning priorities.

  • You ask how marketing supports growth and use that curiosity to learn across content, campaigns, and research - and to improve results.

  • You're genuinely enthusiastic about education and the IB field, and see this role as an opportunity to create real impact.

Practicalities

  • Duration: Typically one semester, aligned with your academic calendar

  • Location: Kognity office in Stockholm, hybrid set-up (50% office attendance)

  • Compensation: Unpaid academic-credit placement, in line with standard Swedish university internship programmes

How we hire

  1. Application review

  2. Introductory call with the Content Marketing Manager

  3. Case assignment

Our values

  • We take ownership

  • We are transparent

  • We make every week count

  • We obsess over customers

  • We show up with heart

Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives and abilities.

See more about how we collect and process your personal data in our Privacy Notice.
